pr_title: roachtest: update sqlalchemy roachtest to use SQLA 1.4
pr_body:
This was failing because we reorganized the project and bumped the
SQL Alchemy supported version to 1.4.17.

Fixes #66075

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/66153)
